title: N0 Elytra
description: This mod removes all elytras from Minecraft, so you can’t fly or glide anymore. Exploring, traveling, and late-game movement all become way slower and more dangerous.
body: No Elytra deletes every elytra in the game, including the one normally found in End Ships. You can’t obtain it, repair it, or use fireworks to fly. Without elytra, players must travel on foot, by boat, or with other slow methods. End Cities become less rewarding, long-distance travel takes much longer, and escaping dangerous situations is harder. It gives the late-game a grounded, survival-focused feel where movement really matters again.
